# Context Map

## Contexts

- [Up](../CONTEXT.md): one level above the root
- [Deeper](../../../../etc/CONTEXT.md): far above the root
- [Absolute](/etc/CONTEXT.md): an absolute path
- [Encoded](%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2fCONTEXT.md): a percent encoded traversal
- [Remote](https://example.invalid/CONTEXT.md): a URL
- [Wrong file](./src/ok/secrets.md): a file that is not a lead
- [Gone](./src/gone/CONTEXT.md): a link that resolves to nothing
- [Ok](./src/nested/../ok/CONTEXT.md): inside the root by way of a parent segment
